# Fixture sources

Inventory of every data file under `tests/fixtures/` (READMEs and the store build script
`stores/build_a2db444_store.py` excluded): origin, journal named in the file, the licence
statement found in the file, and a licence class. This is an inventory only: no fixture was
changed, and whether any should be replaced is the maintainer's decision. Generated by a one-off
script from file headers, the sibling READMEs and `git log`; the class is read from the text of
the file, not from the READMEs. "IUCr journal" means `_journal_name_full` names Acta
Crystallographica (any section) or J. Appl. Cryst.
